topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I woke to the gentle morning light and the soft scent of fresh blooms. Placed delicately on my kitchen table, a bouquet of wildflowers, vibrant and inviting. I ran my fingers over the petals, each one a whisper of nature’s care. There was no card, no note to tell me who had thought of me, but the gift itself spoke volumes. I took a deep breath, letting the beauty of the gesture fill me. As I arranged the flowers in a vase, I felt a warm sense of connection, knowing someone had taken the time to pick these for me, to brighten my day without needing anything in return. The world felt a little softer, a little kinder, with these unexpected blossoms in my home.
